tagline.en: Where the tide leaves its mark.
tagline.zh: 潮水到过的地方，都会留下痕迹。

summary.en: Classic turn-based strategy: build, capture and push on land, sea and air.
summary.zh: 经典 SLG 回合制战棋：造兵、占城、推司令部，陆海空三军同场。

caption.en: Blue squares show where the tank can go; the arrow is its path
caption.zh: 蓝色格子是坦克能到的地方，箭头是它要走的路线

caption.en: After the move: choose what the unit does
caption.zh: 走到位置后，选这支部队做什么

notes.en: Cartoon war between pixel-art armies. No blood.
notes.zh: 像素风格的卡通战争，没有血腥画面。

guide.en: An extension is a folder with a mod.js that calls AWMods.register. The fields are in game/mods/README.md.
guide.zh: 一个扩展是一个文件夹，里面的 mod.js 调用 AWMods.register。字段见 game/mods/README.md。

caption.en: One move: pick a unit, see its range, draw the path
caption.zh: 走一步：选中部队，看移动范围，画出路线
